questions.prompt: Carbon Removals and neutralization: The IPCC scenarios are clear - emission reductions are vital but unfortunately no longer enough to meet the 1.5 degree target. So the world will need permanent carbon removals. The SBTi Corporate Net-Zero standard states that any residual emissions at the target year need to be neutralized with durable carbon removals. By then, the market for durable carbon removals needs to be able to meet this demand. There is a shared responsibility to support innovation and scaling of methods for durable carbon removals. Does your company have any commitment or investment plan for supporting and scaling carbon removals?

Beyond Value Chain Mitigation: There is a gap between what companies and nations have pledged and what the world needs to meet the 1.5 degree target. Financing climate mitigation beyond the company's value chains is crucial and strongly recommended by SBTi. It is not to be confused with carbon offsetting, rather it is a contribution to the global transition to Net-Zero. Is your company engaged in Beyond Value Chain Mitigation (BVCM)?

Private sector companies have a large role to play in the transition to a net zero economy, but they alone cannot bring about this transformation – for their business and the wider economy. That is why companies must advocate for robust public policies, regulations, and investments that are necessary to support corporate action and drive economy-wide decarbonization. Does your company have a formal plan to actively engaging with policy makers to influence legislation that incentivizes decarbonization? If your plan includes formally supporting STICA’s policy work, you can answer yes to this question.
